seed_fact: Local schema markup on every page: includes address, hours, phone. Use schema.org/LocalBusiness.
caption:
Customers near you are searching online right now. If your website doesn’t show your address, hours, and phone in a format search engines understand, you’ll slip down the results. Adding local schema markup tells Google exactly where you are, so you appear in local searches. DM me for a quick check and boost your local visibility.
